verseText: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, observing the evil and the good.
meaning: God sees everything we do. He knows about our secret sins. And he notices when we do good, even if no one else is watching.

recall.question: Where are the eyes of the LORD?

meaning.question: What does this verse teach us about things we do in secret?
choices: God sees both the good and the wrong we do
God notices only when we do something wrong

application.prompt: God notices when you do something kind, even if no one thanks you. He also sees wrong choices that you try to hide. How could remembering that God sees you help you choose what is right when you are alone?
